title: Perturbations of measures and sets having curves in d directions
summary: We show that whenever a separable subset $S$ of a complete metric space $X$ admits a $d$-dimensional weak tangent field, the set $S$ is close to being $d$-dimensional in the following sense. Whenever $μ$ is a Borel finite measure on $X$ supported on $S$, then a typical $1$-Lispchitz map (in the sense of Baire category) into a Euclidean space maps $μ$-almost all of $S$ into a set of Hausdorff dimension at most $d$.
